digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model tracing and instrumentation
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one child OTel span nested under the Agent model-request span, with zero-based ordering and no duplication from instrument_all, verified by in-memory exporter assertions.

Every candidate span must carry provider-qualified model identity, outcome from {returned, raised}, optional provider-reported usage, and sanitized error reason (via sanitize_diagnostic) with no prompt/response/credential/endpoint body exposed.

The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup, fallback selection logic, ProviderSession lifecycle, and S2 bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade control flow must remain unchanged; instrumentation must be purely observational and best-effort.
Span-emission and exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off.

The native-to-prompted downgrade (Mechanism B, _pai_structured) must be legible as two distinct Agent-request spans—native attempt raised then prompted attempt returned—with both runs routing through the same wrapped candidates.
A lean-import without tracing extra dependencies and a tracing-disabled mode must both produce identical result, usage, and exception behavior with no span dependency errors.
